units.source_text: 公子去后，此间无知无识的僧众及童孺，也都伤离惜别，叹息流泪；

en.t: After the young lord had gone, even the simple, unworldly monks here and the children grieved at parting from him, sighed, and shed tears;

units.source_text: 何况寺中老尼姑等人，她们从来不曾见过如此俊秀的美男子；

en.t: how much more so the elderly nuns and others in the temple, who had never before seen such a handsome and graceful young man;

units.source_text: 相与赞叹道：“这不像个尘世间的人。”

en.t: they praised him together, saying, "He does not seem like someone from this mortal world."

units.source_text: 僧都也说：“唉，如此天仙化人，而生在这秽浊扶桑的末世，真乃何等宿缘！

en.t: The bishop also said, "Ah, for such a transformed heavenly being to be born in this impure latter age of Japan, what extraordinary karma it must be!

units.source_text: 想起了反而令人心悲啊！”便举袖拭泪。

en.t: When I think of it, it only makes my heart sorrowful!" Then he raised his sleeve and wiped away his tears.

units.source_text: 那女孩的童心中，也赞慕源氏公子的美貌。

en.t: In the little girl's childish heart, too, there was admiration and longing for Lord Genji's beauty.

units.source_text: 她说：“这个人比爸爸还好看呢！”侍女们说：“那么，姑娘做了他的女儿吧！”

en.t: She said, "This man is even better-looking than Father!" The waiting women said, "Then, young lady, you should become his daughter!"

units.source_text: 她点点头，仿佛在想：“若得如此，我真高兴！”

en.t: She nodded, as if thinking, "If that could happen, I would be so happy!"

units.source_text: 此后每逢弄玩具娃娃或画画，总是假定一个源氏公子，

en.t: After that, whenever she played with dolls or drew pictures, she would always imagine one of them as Lord Genji,

units.source_text: 替他穿上美丽的衣服，真心地爱护他。

en.t: dress him in beautiful clothes, and cherish him with all her heart.
